test_title: PYST 10: SSC CHSL - English (Held On: 10 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underline segment in the given sentence.

Though Mr. Swami __ran in__ debt, he did not stop wasting money.
solution:
The correct answer is, **'ran into**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Into** is used to talk about **a movement or change in place**.

 
 
• Example - ***Katherine ran into Ten at the Coffee House**.*
 
 
 
• The correct sentence would be, **Though Mr. Swami ran into debt, he did not stop wasting money**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] 

**Additional Information__**

 
• **Along** means **going in a line of something**.

 
 
• Example - ***The tables were set along the wall***.
 
 
 
• **To** is used for directions.
 
 
• Example - ***Becky is going to the library***.
 
 
 
• **Over** means **being above something**.
 
 
• Example - ***Maria sees black clouds over the hills***.
